title: Centralize MLX_MODEL constant in daud.const
description: The MLX model ID 'mlx-community/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-8bit' is currently hardcoded in 4 places: src/daud/server_setup.py:34 (MLX_MODEL constant used for LaunchAgent plist generation), src/daud/review_attempts.py:23 (QWEN_MODEL for urllib calls), src/daud/voyage/fixer.py:24 (QWEN_MODEL for urllib calls), src/daud/voyage/reviewer.py:26 (QWEN_MODEL for urllib fallback). README.md:55 also mentions a different default. Add MLX_MODEL constant to src/daud/const.py and import it from all four modules. VALUE UNCHANGED in this ticket (still Qwen). This is a pure refactor that unblocks the Gemma 4 migration, which becomes a one-line change in const.py afterward.
definition-of-done: 1. src/daud/const.py exports MLX_MODEL = 'mlx-community/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-8bit' at module level. 2. server_setup.py, review_attempts.py, voyage/fixer.py, voyage/reviewer.py all import MLX_MODEL from daud.const instead of defining their own string. 3. grep -rn 'Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-8bit' src/ returns exactly one hit (const.py). 4. detect_model() fallback in const.py still resolves correctly when agent-model secret is empty. 5. uv run daud and uv run daud-worker both still work against the current Qwen server.
testing-plan: 1. grep -rn 'Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-8bit' src/ shows only const.py. 2. uv run daud starts and completes a tool call. 3. uv run server-setup regenerates the LaunchAgent plist using the const (verify by reading ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.daud.mlx-server.plist). 4. voyage/reviewer and voyage/fixer still reach the Qwen endpoint (smoke test via uv run daud-worker on a queued ticket, or direct invocation).
